title: 为什么精读胜过零散查词
feynman_summary: Scattered lookup may feel hardworking, but it rarely gives the reader a full understanding of an article. When attention is pulled away again and again, the text stops feeling like a complete idea and turns into separate problems. A guided reading flow offers support without letting the article disappear behind too many tools. Although the learner still meets difficulty, staying with the whole passage makes comprehension deeper and progress more sustainable.
chinese_translation: 零散查词看起来像是在认真学习，但它很少能让读者真正完整地理解一篇文章。当注意力一次又一次被拉走时，文本就不再像一个完整的思想，而会变成一个个分开的难点。引导式阅读流程会提供支持，同时不让文章被过多工具遮住。虽然学习者仍然会遇到困难，但坚持跟住整篇文章会让理解更深入，也让进步更可持续。

sentences.text: Scattered lookup may feel hardworking, but it rarely gives the reader a full understanding of an article.
When attention is pulled away again and again, the text stops feeling like a complete idea and turns into separate problems.
A guided reading flow offers support without letting the article disappear behind too many tools.
Although the learner still meets difficulty, staying with the whole passage makes comprehension deeper and progress more sustainable.

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指查词行为是分散的、不连续的。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: 像纸片 scattered 在桌上，信息散开了，就难以形成整体理解。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指这种做法看起来很用功，但效果未必好。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: hardworking 强调看起来很勤奋，不等于 efficient。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指对整篇内容的深入理解。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: 来自 comprehend，看到 comprehension 就想到“理解这件事本身”。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指这种进步方式能长期坚持下去。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: sustainable progress 是常见搭配，表示不是一阵子猛冲，而是能持续。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指作为整体来阅读的整段文本。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: 做阅读题时常见 read the passage，这里也是提醒你盯住全文。

high_frequency_phrases.usage_note: 适合用来表达是否真正读懂、弄明白一个内容整体。
高频重复表达，口语和写作都常用，用来强调反复发生。
适合用来表达工具过载、流程被复杂化的情况。

language_evolution.rewritten_sentence: Although the learner still meets difficulty, staying with the whole passage makes comprehension deeper and progress more sustainable.
language_evolution.explanation: Although 引导让步状语从句，先承认学习者仍会遇到困难，再强调坚持整篇阅读带来的更好结果。
language_evolution.imitation_example: Although the topic was unfamiliar, she stayed calm and finished the article carefully.
